AnnotationChangesPage.description: A page of the change feed. ``next`` is the ``since`` of the next page.
AnnotationChangesPage.title: AnnotationChangesPage

AnnotationHistory.description:
``GET /api/annotations/history``: an id's label changes and each author's comment,
newest first.
AnnotationHistory.title: AnnotationHistory

Annotations.description:
An id's annotations, as of ``version``: the version of the change that last touched it.
``comments`` holds each author's current comment, oldest first.
Annotations.title: Annotations

AnnotationsChange.description:
``PATCH /api/annotations``: a change to every one of ``ids``.

- Leaving ``label`` out keeps it; ``null`` clears it.
- ``addTags`` and ``removeTags`` change the tags; ``setTags`` (Override) replaces them.
- ``comment`` sets the caller's comment on each id, replacing theirs; ``null`` clears it;
  leaving it out keeps it (ADR-0023).
AnnotationsChange.title: AnnotationsChange

CatalogueAction.description: A query action or, as ``kind: "sink"``, a sink: no params, offered on any selected rows.
CatalogueAction.title: CatalogueAction

CatalogueColumn.description: A column the action declares, with the grid's initial settings for it.
CatalogueColumn.title: CatalogueColumn

CatalogueParam.description: A param of an action, as the tab builds its form from it.
CatalogueParam.title: CatalogueParam

CataloguePivot.description:
How an action is offered in the grid's context menu: on one row or several, when the row
has one column from each group of alternatives.
CataloguePivot.title: CataloguePivot

ChangedAnnotations.description:
The ids the change changed, as they now are, and its version: the current one when it
changed nothing.
ChangedAnnotations.title: ChangedAnnotations

ColumnView.description:
A column view as one analyst sees it: ``owned`` is whether they own it, ``hidden``
whether they hid it.
ColumnView.title: ColumnView

ColumnViewFields.description:
The fields the owner writes: the ``PUT`` body. ``state`` is a partial AG Grid
``GridState``, whose keys only the browser decides (ADR-0022).
ColumnViewFields.title: ColumnViewFields

Comment.description: An author's current comment on an id.
Comment.title: Comment

CommentEntry.description: An author's comment in an id's history, as they last saved it.
CommentEntry.title: CommentEntry

DeclareStatement.description: The statement the action puts before the query to declare its query parameters.
DeclareStatement.title: DeclareStatement

DeclareStatementRequest.description:
Body of ``POST /api/actions/{key}/declareStatement``: the tab's query parameters, in
order.
DeclareStatementRequest.title: DeclareStatementRequest

DeclaredParameter.description: A query parameter as it is declared: its name and type, without a value.
DeclaredParameter.title: DeclaredParameter

EditorSchemaRequest.description:
Body of ``POST /api/connections/{name}/schema``: the values of the editor param's
``schemaFrom`` params, by name, without its connection param.
EditorSchemaRequest.title: EditorSchemaRequest

EditorSchemaResponse.description: What the editor completes from: ``kind`` picks the browser's adapter.
EditorSchemaResponse.title: EditorSchemaResponse

FixedInput.description: A param input whose value is saved with the preset. Its type is the param's.
FixedInput.title: FixedInput

FixedQueryParameter.description:
A query parameter whose value is saved with the preset: a name in the query, declared
with ``type``.
FixedQueryParameter.title: FixedQueryParameter

FromRowInput.description:
A param input filled from the first of ``fromColumns`` the rows have. With no columns, the
form asks the analyst for it.
FromRowInput.title: FromRowInput

FromRowQueryParameter.description:
A query parameter filled from the first of ``fromColumns`` the rows have; a ``dynamic`` one
takes every distinct value. With no columns, the form asks the analyst for it.
FromRowQueryParameter.title: FromRowQueryParameter

Instance.description: ``version`` changes whenever anything else here, or an installed provider, does.
Instance.title: Instance

InstanceConnection.description: A connection as the browser sees it: never its endpoint or auth.
InstanceConnection.title: InstanceConnection

InstanceLabel.description: A label from the labels file: ``colour`` and ``symbol`` name ones the browser draws.
InstanceLabel.title: InstanceLabel

LabelEntry.description: A label change in an id's history: the label it set, ``null`` when it cleared it.
LabelEntry.title: LabelEntry

LabelState.description: An id's label: its key, who set it and when.
LabelState.title: LabelState

Me.description: The caller as the API knows them: ``name`` is what their comments, presets and runs carry.
Me.title: Me

NewColumnView.description: The ``POST`` body: ``savedFrom`` is fixed at creation.
NewColumnView.title: NewColumnView

PivotResolution.description:
A pivot's params, as wire values, and the params it couldn't fill.
``reasons`` says why for those that have a reason, such as rows that disagree.
PivotResolution.title: PivotResolution

PivotRows.description: The selected rows, by value, each trimmed to the action's pivot columns.
PivotRows.title: PivotRows

Preset.description:
A preset as one analyst sees it: ``owned`` is whether they own it, ``hidden`` whether
they hid it.
Preset.title: Preset

PresetFields.description: The fields the owner writes: the ``POST`` and ``PUT`` body.
PresetFields.title: PresetFields

RowsPage.description:
``lastRow`` is the run's row count. ``annotations`` are those of the rows' ids that have
any, current as of ``annotationVersion``.
RowsPage.title: RowsPage

Run.description:
A run without its rows. Server-produced only, never a request.

``params`` are the resolved params, ``{}`` for a sink. ``details`` holds TIM's ``duration``
(seconds) and ``rowCount`` first, or a sink's ``duration`` and ``inputRowCount``, then the
action's own, in the order they were reported. ``columns`` and ``rowCount`` are set once a
query action's run succeeds, never for a sink; ``error`` is a message safe to show.
Run.title: Run

RunColumn.description: A result column: ``declared`` by the action or the run, else inferred from the rows.
RunColumn.title: RunColumn

RunRow.description:
One result row. ``row`` is its row number, unique within the run; ``id`` is what it is
annotated by, and may repeat.
RunRow.title: RunRow

RunStatus.description: A run waiting for a concurrency slot is ``running`` too.
RunStatus.title: RunStatus

SavedFrom.description: The action, and the preset when there is one, of the tab the view was saved from.
SavedFrom.title: SavedFrom

SinkInput.description: The rows a sink writes, each a row's ``data``, and their columns.
SinkInput.title: SinkInput

StartRun.description:
Body of ``POST /api/runs``. The params are validated against the action's; ``input`` is
for a sink, and only a sink.
StartRun.title: StartRun

TagSuggestions.description:
Tags that start with a prefix: the analyst's own, most recently added first, then the
others, most used first.
TagSuggestions.title: TagSuggestions
